newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends up on technical strength, spreads.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends up on technical strength, spreads.

text.p: CBOT rice futures bounced back to end higher Friday amid ideas that Thursday's losses were overdone, traders said.
Spread trade remained the market's primary feature, pit sources said.
"We've put a lot of carry (charges) into the market this week," said one trader with ties to the cash market.

The sharp move in the January/March spread, which widened from three cents last week to as much as 12 cents this week indicated that near-term demand for rice had largely been satisfied, a trader said.
However, continued commercial buying in deferred contracts indicated strong demand for new crop rice, traders said.
Weekly export sales of 25,600 tonnes, reported by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, were considered mediocre and had little influence on trading Friday, pit sources said.
Rice volume was estimated at 650 contracts, down from 887 on Thursday, according to CBOT data.
Rice closed two to 12 cents per cwt higher, with January up five cents at $10.97 per cwt.
